note:
ISO 2026-W36 runs from August 31 through September 6. Fixed-sky highlights include M71, globular cluster in Sagitta. Venus is about 1.5° in ecliptic longitude from Spica in Virgo. Uranus is about 4.1° in ecliptic longitude from Aldebaran in Taurus.

**Naked eye:** 🌗 Last Quarter — 07:51:14 UTCAltair (α Aql) — V 1 — Tropical SummerM27, Dumbbell Nebula, planetary nebula in Vulpecula — V 7.4 — Tropical Summer. Moderate moonlight makes timing and local sky position important for faint targets. Use the brightest seasonal stars and the zodiac as the week’s fixed-sky framework.

**Planets:** Venus is about 1.5° in ecliptic longitude from Spica in Virgo. Uranus is about 4.1° in ecliptic longitude from Aldebaran in Taurus.

**Binoculars:** Favor M71, globular cluster in Sagitta; wide fields help connect the charted geometry to the real sky.

**Small telescope:** Concentrate on M71, globular cluster in Sagitta. Increase magnification only after the target and surrounding pattern are secure.
